name: dynamic storage retains plain class identity
source: class Plain { value: number = 1; } function main(): void { const source = new Plain(); const values: Plain[] = []; const exposed: any = values; exposed[0] = source; console.log(values[0] === source, values[0] instanceof Plain); const object: any = new Function("return {value: 2}")(); exposed[1] = object; console.log(values[1] === object, values[1] instanceof Plain); }
